note: No challan discount or settlement scheme is in force in Andhra Pradesh — reconfirmed on 1 November 2026 against the Andhra Pradesh Transport Department's site (aptransport.org, which loaded in full today, with a Penalties section covering only Prosecution and Compounding, no discount/amnesty scheme) and a current press search, neither of which shows any new scheme announced. The central e-challan portal (echallan.parivahan.gov.in) returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable when tried today, the same as prior cycles. Discounts here come only through National Lok Adalat sittings, where the bench decides each case individually. Check and pay challans at the full amount on the official e-challan portal.
